subject: Next steps: budget holder + security path for ClearHealth POC
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya@clearhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 14:10:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps: budget holder + security path for ClearHealth POC

Hi Maya —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and concrete next steps so nothing falls through the cracks: 

- Goal: 2–3 week POC to validate latency/cost for your patient-notes summarization flow, then a Q2 pilot if successful.
- Success criteria you mentioned: < 150ms median token latency for 1–2k daily active users, reproducible summary quality on our eval prompts, and a clear procurement path for a 6–12 month pilot.

Immediate asks from your side:
1) Please confirm the person who ultimately signs the budget (budget owner/econ buyer) and their preferred contact (name/email).
2) Procurement/legal who will own contract redlines and the initial security gate (SOC2, vendor questionnaire).
3) Any hard date constraints for vendor selection (you mentioned "end of Q2"—is that still the target?).

From our side:
- I attached a short SOW template and a security matrix to speed procurement/security reviews.
- Karthik will follow up with a concise pricing range tailored to the POC footprint.
- Dev is looped to answer any technical security or integration questions (network diagrams, egress, key management).

Proposed short next steps:
- Maya: reply with budget owner + procurement contact by end of week.
- Karthik: send ballpark POC pricing and a one-page mutual action plan by Thu.
- Dev: prepare answers for the security matrix (I asked for the carrier/network diagram if you can share).

Happy to connect for 20 minutes with the budget owner and procurement if that speeds things up — I can hold a deferred intro call and walk through key commercial points.

Best,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0143

Attachments: RWI_SOW_template_v1.pdf (outline), security_matrix_v2.xlsx (answers TBD)

From: Maya Singh <maya@clearhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>, procurement@clearhealth.com
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: budget holder + security path for ClearHealth POC

Thanks Sofia — useful recap. Quick answers below and a couple of notes: 

- Budget owner: Luke Turner (CFO) — luke.turner@clearhealth.com. He handles pilot approvals for infra/AI spend.
- Procurement/legal: procurement@clearhealth.com (contracts team will handle redlines; legal reviews go via the procurement alias first).
- Timeline: still aiming for vendor selection by the end of Q2; target internal approval meeting mid-May.

Security notes: our security team will want SOC 2 Type II evidence, encryption-at-rest details, and a brief on key management (KMS/HSM). They usually expect a short turnaround on the vendor questionnaire (7–10 business days). Can you confirm if you have a standard packet?

If you can send a brief pricing range for the POC (monthly run-rate estimate) that will help me justify the ask to Luke. Happy to intro you to Luke on a short call — he likes 15–20 minute walkthroughs that stick to cost and risk.

I attached our internal vendor checklist for reference (high level). Will loop Luke once we have the mutual action plan and pricing.

—Maya
Maya Singh
Director, Clinical Ops | ClearHealth
maya@clearhealth.com | +1 646-555-0129

Attachments: ClearHealth_Vendor_Checklist.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya@clearhealth.com>, Luke Turner <luke.turner@clearhealth.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>, procurement@clearhealth.com
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: POC pricing range + proposed mutual action plan

Hi Maya / Luke — looping in following Sofia's thread. Short note on pricing and next steps so the CFO has what he needs for an initial decision: 

POC estimate (ballpark) — 3 week POC targeting 2000 DAU simulation:~ $8k–$12k total (depends on batching, KV cache share, and quantization choices).
- Hosted trial (Redwood API): closer to $8k.
- Dedicated small GPU pool (reserved capacity for tighter latency): toward $12k

Proposed MAP (mutual action plan):
- Week 0: Security questionnaire sent (we provided security_matrix_v2.xlsx) + SOW draft (attached).
- Week 1: Integration support + test data ingestion.
- Week 2: Live run + evaluation against your test prompts.
- Week 3: Evaluation review and decision meeting (pilot vs. stop).

We can tighten the estimate once we agree on exact throughput assumptions and KV cache retention. Dev — can you review the security matrix and flag any items that require architecture artifacts?

Next ask: Maya — if this range looks reasonable, can Sofia set a 20-min intro with Luke next week (Mon/Tue preferred)? Procurement team, we'll send the SOW + security matrix and a DocuSign link for a simple pilot addendum to speed things along once terms are agreed.

Thanks,
Karthik
Principal Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
To: Luke Turner <luke.turner@clearhealth.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya@clearhealth.com>, procurement@clearhealth.com, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + 20 min to confirm budget path for ClearHealth POC

Luke — quick intro and thank you for taking a look. Maya and I spoke last week and she recommended I reach out to you to align on commercial approach for a 3-week POC. Below are the key points and asks, pulled from our earlier thread: 

- Objective: validate latency and summary quality on patient-notes use case; pilot decision by end of Q2.
- Estimated POC range: $8k–$12k (hosted -> small dedicated).
- Security gating: SOC2 evidence + security matrix answers (we provided a template to speed review).

Would you have 20 minutes this week for a quick run-through of scope and numbers? Proposed times: Tue 3/3 10:00–10:20 PT or Wed 3/4 14:00–14:20 PT. If neither works, tell me two windows that do and I will coordinate.

If helpful, I can include a one-page pricing snapshot and the SOW in advance. Looking forward to a short intro — I’ll keep it tightly focused on cost/approval items only.

Best,
Sofia
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0143
